SELECT h.*, w.name AS warehouse_name, l.code AS location_code, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, sp.name AS partner_name, u.nickname AS release_by_name FROM wms_stock_hold h JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = h.material_id JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = h.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = h.location_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON sp.id = h.partner_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = h.release_by
h.status = #{status} AND h.source_no = #{sourceNo}
AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR h.source_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CASE h.status WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 0 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, h.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_stock_hold SET status = CASE WHEN qty = #{qty} THEN #{doneStatus} ELSE status END, qty = qty - #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND qty >= #{qty} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT material_id AS "materialId", SUM(qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock_hold WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY material_id
